content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe face significant hurdles when trying to sell their products online. Conventional platforms such as PayPal and Stripe are often unavailable or operate under restrictive policies. This leaves creators locked out of profitable digital opportunities. The solution lies in a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-8|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-github-pages-free-digital-product-9|architecture]] that enables creators to build their own digital product stores with no KYC [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-my-unfiltered-take|Payment Gateways]]s, ensuring full ownership and minimal transaction fees. This approach not only empowers creators but also represents a shift towards financial independence.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-7. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

The architecture behind a digital product store with no KYC payments is built on a foundation of sovereignty. This means that creators have complete control over their sales infrastructure without relying on traditional payment processors. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, creators can set up their stores to accept payments in cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for accounts tied to banks or payment platforms. This matters because it allows anyone, anywhere, to sell digital products with minimal fees and maximum autonomy.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this architecture is the combination of free tools that work seamlessly together. Cloudflare Pages is used for hosting, while backend logic can be implemented using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage is managed through Supabase or Google Sheets, and product delivery is executed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments facilitates automatic crypto payment processing at a mere 0.5% fee, compared to the 10% charged by platforms like Gumroad. This architecture not only streamlines the sales process but also protects the creator's data and assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where conventional payment solutions are obstructive or unavailable. It serves those selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products who demand reliable payment processing without the burdens of KYC requirements. By embracing this infrastructure, creators can operate their businesses on their terms, free from the constraints imposed by traditional platforms. It offers a viable alternative that strengthens their position in the global marketplace.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, keeping more revenue in your pocket.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this architecture include various freely accessible tools that integrate efficiently to create a robust digital store. Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order management form the backbone. NOWPayments processes cryptocurrency transactions, providing creators with a low-fee alternative to conventional payment processors. Each component is designed to work together, ensuring that the entire system operates smoothly and securely, giving creators full control over their sales processes.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign digital store, start by selecting Cloudflare Pages for your hosting solution. Next, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Choose Supabase or Google Sheets to manage your product orders. For product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto payment processing. You can take action today by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the blueprints and templates needed to get your store up and running.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a sovereign architecture built on free tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. This allows you to set up a digital product store that processes payments in cryptocurrency without KYC requirements. You maintain full ownership of your sales infrastructure and keep more of your revenue.
Full ownership of your sales infrastructure means no ongoing fees or subscriptions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators looking to sell digital products without the limitations of major payment processors, exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is essential. This kit provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to create a fully functional digital store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
